notes: The clause lōʾ hēnîʾ ʾōtāh is asyndetic, so the ASV's third coordinating and is added under rule 14's closing sentence and is not folded into the negative or the verb; the verse writes two waws against three English and's.
The supplied object it of heard it answers to no morpheme and is added under rule 44.
The postposed not is discontinuous from disallowed under rule 25, the negative keeping only its own word since the ASV writes no fused cannot.
